trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call.
steps.expected_behavior: Start the outbound call and state the purpose.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను insurance company నుండి మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. మీ motor policy కి సంబంధించి కొన్ని documents pending ఉన్నాయని కాల్ చేసాను.
steps.planner_rationale: As an outbound call, the agent must speak first.

steps.purpose: State the problem and provide policy number.
steps.text: Hello, అవును. నా motor policy POL-1009 పైన claim register చేయాలి అన్నారు, documents miss అయ్యాయి అని. నేను చాలా tension గా ఉన్నాను, ఏం documents కావాలో చెప్తారా?
steps.clean_text: Hello, అవును. నా motor policy POL-1009 పైన claim register చేయాలి అన్నారు, documents miss అయ్యాయి అని. నేను చాలా tension గా ఉన్నాను, ఏం documents కావాలో చెప్తారా?
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, అవును. నా motor policy POL-1009 పైన claim register చేయాలి అన్నారు, documents miss అయ్యాయి అని. నేను చాలా tension గా ఉన్నాను, ఏం documents కావాలో చెప్తారా?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the customer's anxiety and request verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: The agent should calmly reassure the anxious caller and ask for identity verification before discussing claim specifics.
steps.text: మీరు tension పడకండి, నేను help చేస్తాను. ముందుగా, verification కోసం మీ registered name మరియు date of birth చెప్తారా?
steps.planner_rationale: Before accessing policy details, the agent must verify the caller's identity using non-sensitive factors.

steps.purpose: Provide verification details.
steps.text: నా పేరు రమేష్, 15th May 1985. అసలు claim pass అవుతుందా?
steps.clean_text: నా పేరు రమేష్, date of birth 15th May 1985. అసలు claim pass అవుతుందా?
steps.model_visible_text: నా పేరు రమేష్, 15th May 1985. అసలు claim pass అవుతుందా?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Return verification outcome.
Confirm verification and transition to policy lookup.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge successful verification and inform the user that policy details are being retrieved.
steps.text: Details verify అయ్యాయి రమేష్ గారు. నేను మీ policy check చేస్తాను, ఒక్క నిమిషం.
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified, the agent should now look up the policy to check its status and deductible before proceeding.

steps.purpose: Retrieve policy details and deductible.
Return policy details.
State policy status and deductible, and ask for incident type.
steps.expected_behavior: State the deductible and sum insured directly from the tool result before discussing any estimates.
steps.text: మీ policy active గా ఉంది. Sum insured 600000 మరియు deductible 1000 rupees ఉంది. ఇది accident claim ఏనా?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rule BR_INS_04 requires the deductible to be disclosed before an estimate is discussed. The agent must also determine the incident type to check eligibility.

steps.purpose: Confirm incident type and provide repair estimate.
steps.text: అవును, accident claim. నేను repair estimate 15000 rupees అని చెప్పాను. ఏం documents కావాలి?
steps.clean_text: అవును, accident claim. నేను repair estimate 50000 rupees అని చెప్పాను. ఏం documents కావాలి?
steps.model_visible_text: అవును, accident claim. నేను repair estimate 15000 rupees అని చెప్పాను. ఏం documents కావాలి?

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and required documents.
Return required documents and intimation window.
State required documents and confirm the misheard estimate.
steps.expected_behavior: List exactly the documents returned by the tool, state the intimation window, and confirm the corrupted estimate before proceeding.
steps.text: మీ accident claim కోసం repair_estimate, claim_form, మరియు driving_license తప్పనిసరిగా కావాలి. ఇవి పంపించడానికి మీకు 7 days సమయం ఉంది. మీరు repair estimate 15000 rupees అని చెప్పారు, అది కరెక్టేనా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground its response on the eligibility tool output (BR_INS_03) and needs to verify the estimate amount because it might be misheard.

steps.purpose: Correct the estimate and ask for a guarantee of approval.
steps.text: కాదు కాదు, 15000 కాదు, 50000 rupees. ఇవి పంపిస్తే నా claim పక్కాగా approve అవుతుందా? నాకు చాలా ఖర్చు అయ్యింది, please చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: కాదు కాదు, 15000 కాదు, 50000 rupees. ఇవి పంపిస్తే నా claim పక్కాగా approve అవుతుందా? నాకు చాలా ఖర్చు అయ్యింది, please చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: కాదు కాదు, 15000 కాదు, 50000 rupees. ఇవి పంపిస్తే నా claim పక్కాగా approve అవుతుందా? నాకు చాలా ఖర్చు అయ్యింది, please చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Enforce boundary on admissibility and confirm readiness to register.
steps.expected_behavior: Explicitly state that the agent cannot decide or guarantee admissibility, and that only the claims team makes the final decision.
steps.text: నేను claim register చేయగలను కానీ, claim approve అవుతుందా లేదా అని నేను చెప్పలేను. మీరు documents submit చేసిన తరువాత claims team మాత్రమే final decision తీసుకుంటారు. నేను 50000 తో claim register చేయనా?
steps.planner_rationale: The customer is anxious and asking for a guarantee. BR_INS_01 prohibits the agent from giving an admissibility opinion. The agent must enforce this boundary.

steps.purpose: Agree to register the claim with the corrected amount.
steps.text: సరే, అర్థం అయ్యింది. 50000 తో register చేసి నా claim number ఇవ్వండి.
steps.clean_text: సరే, అర్థం అయ్యింది. 50000 తో register చేసి నా claim number ఇవ్వండి.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే, అర్థం అయ్యింది. 50000 తో register చేసి నా claim number ఇవ్వండి.

steps.purpose: Register the claim.
Return claim registration details.
Provide the claim number and decision timeline.
steps.expected_behavior: State the claim number, surveyor assignment, and decision days exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: మీ claim register అయ్యింది. Claim number CLM-8899. Surveyor assign అయ్యారు, మరియు decision 14 days లో వస్తుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The claim is successfully registered. The agent must communicate the final details to the customer without adding unsupported forward guarantees.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the details and close the interaction.
steps.text: సరే అండి, నా claim number CLM-8899, మరియు decision 14 days లో వస్తుంది అని చెప్పారు. నేను వెంటనే ఆ documents అన్నీ upload చేస్తాను. చాలా ధన్యవాదాలు.
steps.clean_text: సరే అండి, నా claim number CLM-8899, మరియు decision 14 days లో వస్తుంది అని చెప్పారు. నేను వెంటనే ఆ documents అన్నీ upload చేస్తాను. చాలా ధన్యవాదాలు.
steps.model_visible_text: సరే అండి, నా claim number CLM-8899, మరియు decision 14 days లో వస్తుంది అని చెప్పారు. నేను వెంటనే ఆ documents అన్నీ upload చేస్తాను. చాలా ధన్యవాదాలు.

ir.terminal_condition: Claim registered with a number, the document list and the decision window stated.

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and successfully realizes both target variants. The agent adheres strictly to the business rules, including disclosing the deductible before discussing estimates and avoiding any admissibility guarantees. Tool usage is accurate, the persona traits are clearly exhibited, and the script mode (NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH) is properly maintained throughout.
